sections.title: Upward and downward movement
sections.content:
Vocabulary for describing statistical or economic changes:
• surge — a sudden large increase. There was a surge in online shopping during the pandemic.
• plummet — fall sharply and rapidly. Oil prices plummeted by 30% overnight.
• fluctuate — rise and fall irregularly. Currency exchange rates fluctuate daily.
• soar — rise quickly to a high level. House prices soared in the last decade.
• decline — gradually decrease. The population in rural areas continues to decline.
• stagnate — stop developing or making progress. Wages have stagnated while living costs rise.

sections.title: Describing the pace of change
sections.content:
How quickly change happens:
• gradual — happening slowly over time. There has been a gradual shift in public opinion.
• dramatic — sudden and striking. The company saw dramatic growth in its second year.
• steady — consistent and unchanging in direction. There has been a steady increase in life expectancy.
• unprecedented — never happened before. The heatwave was unprecedented in recorded history.

exercises.question: A sudden, large increase is called a:
exercises.explanation: A surge is a sudden, powerful increase.

exercises.question: If prices fall sharply and rapidly, they:
exercises.explanation: Plummet means to fall or drop straight down at high speed.

exercises.question: When something goes up and down irregularly, it:
exercises.explanation: Fluctuate means to rise and fall irregularly in number or amount.

exercises.question: Something that has never happened before in history is:
exercises.explanation: Unprecedented means never done or known before.

exercises.question: When wages stop growing and remain at the same level, they:
exercises.explanation: Stagnate means to cease developing or making progress.

exercises.question: A change that happens slowly over a long period is:
exercises.hint: Step by step, not all at once.
exercises.explanation: Gradual means taking place or progressing slowly over a period of time.

exercises.question: When house prices rise very quickly to a high level, they:
exercises.explanation: Soar means to increase rapidly above the usual level.

exercises.question: A consistent increase that doesn't change pace is:
exercises.explanation: Steady means regular, even, and continuous in development.
